# DifferentiableRasterizationPipeline

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An end-to-end differentiable rendering pipeline that enables gradient-based optimization of scene parameters directly from image losses. Highlights a learning paradigm where forward rendering and backward gradients flow through a structured computational graph, relevant for training in-network or neuromorphic architectures.
